title: CNB FINANCIAL CORP/PA 8-K Filing — 2026-04-14
summary: CNB Financial Corporation (CCNE), a Pennsylvania-based regional bank, filed Form 8-K on April 14, 2026 to announce a quarterly cash dividend on its 7.125% Series A Fixed-Rate Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock. The dividend of $17.8125 per preferred share ($0.4453125 per depositary share) will be paid on June 1, 2026 to shareholders of record as of May 15, 2026.
